title: Homogeneity of corporate risk perceptions and systemic financial risk
core_idea: Use text mining of firms' risk factor disclosures to extract perceived risks, quantify homogeneity of risk perceptions within and across sectors, and evaluate how those perceptions relate to financial interconnectedness and systemic financial risk.
tldr: The paper proposes extracting corporate risk perceptions from disclosure texts to measure perception homogeneity and investigate its connection to financial interconnectedness and systemic risk.
